CONTACT

Start with a direct note.

For a discreet first conversation with Lir Capital, email the team directly. A short, practical note helps us understand fit, context and timing, and route the enquiry carefully.

partners@lircap.com

WHAT TO INCLUDE

Give enough context for a sensible first response.
